Omarchy palette provenance

Nema includes declarative color values from the 22 stock palettes in Omarchy.
Source: https://github.com/thanosapollo/omarchy
Commit: b7771e607b9f374891b97e03d10f69abc322535f

Rum palette provenance

The Rum palette is Thanos Apollo's palette, sourced separately from his dotfiles
at commit c918885129913597cccb51f870a1cbe7529167c0. Nema displays it as Default.
